weaknesses.title: AGEALL treats directories as HIT (real mtime) while SIZEALL treats them as MISS
weaknesses.detail: Inconsistent bag-map semantics: AGEALL on nested/ succeeds with age seconds (often 0 if just created); SIZEALL on same path is MISS+0. Agents cannot share KEEPFILES-optional pipelines across size and age boards safely.
weaknesses.repro: AGEALL paths_with_dir → nested:0 AGEALL_HIT includes dir; SIZEALL → SIZEALL_MISS

weaknesses.title: No AGEALL name:age / path:age single-shot — need BASENAMEALL+ZIP
weaknesses.detail: Same class as SIZEALL: parallel decimal bag only. Desync if PATHS filtered after ages without remap.

weaknesses.title: AGEALL age 0 == brand-new and == just-created dir pollution
weaknesses.detail: Fresh files age 0; dirs also often 0. THRESHKV min=1 drops both fresh files and dir noise — cannot keep zero-age files if filtering dirs via age alone.

weaknesses.title: NEWEST_N is mtime epoch not age seconds; LARGEST_N is bytes
weaknesses.detail: Side-channel units differ across pick ops sharing *_N suffix. Agents must remember NEWEST_N≠age.

weaknesses.title: No AGEALL threshold filter on path bag (keep paths age>=min)
weaknesses.detail: Stale path selection needs ZIP to KV then THRESHKV then KEYS peel — multi-step. No KEEPOLD/FILTERAGE path op.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON bag newline collapse
weaknesses.detail: Ages bag collapses to digit run e.g. "013" unreadable as array.

weaknesses.title: No bulk utime set — cannot fabricate historical mtimes in-language
weaknesses.detail: Tests need host sleep/touch -d. TOUCH only refreshes to now. Blocks pure-CubalC stale fixture setup.

workarounds: Always KEEPFILES before AGEALL for file-only freshness
Remap ages after any PATHS reorder/filter
THRESHKV min>=1 to drop age-0 noise including fresh+dirs
Read NEWEST_N as epoch; LARGEST_N as bytes
Host touch -d / sleep for age fixtures
language_gaps: Consistent dir policy across SIZEALL vs AGEALL
KEEPOLD/FILTERAGE path bag by age threshold
